thread:
maria_support: Customer on enterprise plan reports stream closing mid-event after ~75s. Client sees partial JSON and immediately reconnects, which causes duplicate token billing. Repro steps attached. Any quick triage?

ingrid_sre: Do we know the exact path? CF -> ALB -> app? Any nginx/Envoy in front?

maria_support: Yep CF -> ALB -> internal nginx -> app. Repro curl they ran:
```
curl -v -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.acme.com/v1/live?session=abc123\" 
```
The client receives a truncated event: `\{"id\":123,\"text\":\"incomplete` then connection closed.

sam_dev: App logs show it flushed the event and returned 200. No stack traces.

nate_platform: edge-bot: streaming_error_count spiked for /v1/live at 2026-03-05T18:03Z :warning:

ingrid_sre: Sounds like midstream teardown by an intermediary. ALB default idle timeout is 60s — could be closing after steady-state silence. Cloudflare also sometimes buffers/terminates persistent connections differently (h2->h1 conversion). Can we get a pcap of the connection teardown?

maria_support: Captured pcap. It shows ALB TCP FIN ~75s after last data. Cloudflare then sends RST to client. Client immediately reconnects.

sam_dev: Two immediate mitigation options:
- Emit small heartbeat comments from the app every 10-15s (SSE-friendly), or
- Raise ALB idle timeout to >=120s and ensure origin keepalive is enabled.

ingrid_sre: Also check nginx `proxy_read_timeout` / `send_timeout` and Envoy `stream_idle_timeout` if present. Those will also kill streams.

maria_support: I shared the pcap + the heartbeat suggestion with the customer. They want a hosted-side mitigation we can suggest while they change infra. Any objections to putting heartbeat example in support KB and a short note about ALB defaults?

sam_dev: Go ahead. Also cc @nate_platform to follow up on billing dedupe.

nate_platform: Got it — I'll create a ticket to add a 30s dedupe window for streaming sessions and add telemetry to detect dup-billing events.

maria_support: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for now; re-open if customer still sees truncation after heartbeat or ALB change. :thumbsup:
